tasks.short: Obtain required approvals and notify affected persons

steps.what: Gather actual site, proposed activity and responsible-person details for the required approval application
inputs: actual proposed activity and site
actual responsible-person details
current instructions from the relevant approving authority
outputs: worker-checked application facts and required approval route

steps.what: Complete and check the exact required application, attachments and authority destination
inputs: worker-checked application facts and required approval route
existing verified applicant identity fields
outputs: complete checked approval application and destination

steps.what: Submit the exact checked application to the relevant authority
inputs: complete checked approval application and destination

steps.what: Read the authority's actual returned decision and verify permission scope, conditions and validity before proceeding
inputs: actual authority-issued decision on the submitted application
actual proposed activity and site
outputs: worker-verified actual approval and conditions, or explicit stop

steps.what: Identify the actual persons requiring notification and verify their contact details and area coverage
inputs: worker-verified actual approval and conditions, or explicit stop
actual site and affected-person information
outputs: worker-checked affected-person recipient list and unresolved coverage gaps

steps.what: Prepare and finish checking the exact required notices, approved activity details and recipients
inputs: worker-verified actual approval and conditions, or explicit stop
worker-checked affected-person recipient list and unresolved coverage gaps
authority's applicable notice instructions
outputs: complete checked notices and recipients, or hold for unresolved approval or coverage

steps.what: Send only the exact checked notices to the verified recipients when approval and coverage checks pass
inputs: complete checked notices and recipients, or hold for unresolved approval or coverage
outputs: actual notices sent and delivery results, or retained hold

tasks.design: Use native reusable applicant fields in {GOV_PORTAL} and approved notice headings in {DOCS}. The worker checks the actual authority decision and affected-person coverage before preparing and sending each final notice through {EMAIL}; no system grants permission or chooses a control method.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications and notices can repeat verified identity and site fields while still requiring case-specific checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form fields and document templates can reuse those facts without generating permission claims.
tasks.still_hard: Identify the correct approval route, actual permission conditions and everyone requiring notice.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve scope and recipient gaps before any activity or communication proceeds.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated form entry while preserving actual approval and notification checks.

reach.learn: Actual proposed activity and site facts; no decision is inferred from submission

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; authority form access, responsible-person consultation and contact-data permission

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approval applications and affected-person notices involve actual site facts, an authority's decision and verified recipients; templates can reuse repeated identity fields.

assumptions: Scenario is an actual required approval application with digital notices accepted by the relevant instructions; no claim about current law or permitted substances/methods is made. Physical notices or calls require their actual work if locally required.

Worker gathers site facts in s1 and recipient facts in s5. Authority produces the actual decision after submission; its adjudication labor and elapsed waiting are outside focal hours and never claimed as saved. Missing approval, conditions or recipients stop the notice.

Native forms/templates first; no generated operational guidance or automatic permission. Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 4.8 minus 1 template/contact upkeep gives 3.8 net; both short sends remain fully retained.
unknowns: Actual approving authority, accepted notification channels and complete affected-person coverage
research_questions: Which fields are actually repeated, and do the authority's instructions accept the proposed form and notice channel?

already_counted.description: Complete and check actual application and notice payloads

incremental.description: Maintain approved template fields and recipient-data handling

approvals.approved_version: complete application and authority destination checked at end of s2; edits void check
complete notices and recipients checked at end of s6 against actual approval; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native forms already suffice or channels require different handling; cautious range below provisional 3.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach and guide people unfamiliar with hunting methods or prey

steps.what: Assess the group's actual experience, understanding and conditions relevant to the planned guidance
inputs: participants' actual experience and questions
actual field conditions
existing approved activity plan
outputs: guide's assessment of participant needs and activity limits

steps.what: Teach the relevant concepts and demonstrate the specific method at an appropriate level for the participants
inputs: guide's assessment of participant needs and activity limits
actual participant questions
outputs: instruction and demonstration delivered to participants

steps.what: Guide the individuals or group in the actual field activity, check understanding and correct observed difficulties
inputs: instruction and demonstration delivered to participants
participants' actual behavior and field conditions
outputs: guided activity and actual participant understanding observed

tasks.design: Retain direct field teaching and guidance. Existing approved reference material in {DOCS} can support the guide's knowledge, but it does not replace assessing participants, demonstrating or observing their behavior.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance depends on actual participant understanding and changing field conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No new digital input establishes those observations or replaces live guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt instruction and respond to behavior in the field.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new system or participant processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: field guidance requires assessing and observing actual participants; reference material alone does not perform that work.

assumptions: This is live teaching and guiding, not production of a course or certification record. No separate lookup, written report, completion entry or message send is established by the statement; any actual local record must be mapped before estimating it.
Native reference access considered first, but learning and participant observation remain situational. No administrative preparation baseline is added just to create a saving.
Shares are provisional, not measurements. All work retained, gross and net zero.
unknowns: Whether the local activity requires a separate participant or completion record
research_questions: Observe live guidance and identify any actual record or repeated source lookup distinct from instruction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction to actual field teaching and guidance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in wildlife management, damage control, disease control and research

steps.what: Read the actual program instructions, assigned area and required observation fields
inputs: authorized program instructions and assignment
actual applicable observation protocol
outputs: worker-understood field assignment and observation requirements

steps.what: Participate in the assigned wildlife, animal-damage, disease-control or research field activity and make actual observations
inputs: worker-understood field assignment and observation requirements
actual animals, site and field conditions
outputs: actual field participation and observed findings with limitations

steps.what: Enter and finish checking actual observations and activity outcomes in the existing program field record
inputs: actual field participation and observed findings with limitations
worker-understood field assignment and observation requirements
existing program and assignment identifiers

steps.what: Save the checked observation record in the same program system
inputs: complete checked field-activity observation record

tasks.design: Configure native observation headings and existing assignment identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The worker performs the actual assigned activity and supplies every observation; defaults do not assert animal counts, disease findings or completed work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated assignment fields and form layout can add entry work to actual field observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native program forms can reuse assignment identifiers and approved observation headings.
tasks.still_hard: Make reliable observations in variable field conditions and recognize limits.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish observed findings from inference or an uncompleted plan.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: wildlife and research field programs use observation records; native forms can supply assignment metadata while workers enter actual findings.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the program's existing field-observation record. This is a field-participation scenario with a normal observation entry, not a new research report or disease diagnosis.

Program owner produces instructions and assignment identifiers; worker produces actual findings in s2 and captures them in s3, retaining that labor. Native form configuration first; no model-generated field facts.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 1.4 minus 0.3 form upkeep gives 1.1 net. Same-system save is 1% fully retained; ordinary checking remains in authoring.
unknowns: Actual field-record requirements and repeated metadata burden
research_questions: Does the native program form remove repeated metadata entry without defaulting unobserved outcomes?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual field findings

approvals.approved_version: complete actual field-observation record checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if forms already suffice; cautious range below provisional 1.1% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Authorities issue actual permission decisions; program owners define field requirements.
skills_to_grow: Verify actual permission and notification coverage
Use native field forms without default outcome claims
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated application and field-record entry while keeping authority decisions, affected-person notification checks and actual field guidance with people.
